docs.title: About this book
docs.text:
A handbook of statecraft addressed to a new prince.

From Standard Ebooks · CC0 1.0

Niccolò Machiavelli (1469–1527), Il Principe (written 1513), in the English translation of W. K. Marriott (died 1927), 1908. This book is not stored in this library: each chapter is read from the public repository of its Standard Ebooks edition when it is opened, shown in this library's format, and ends with its own attribution. Standard Ebooks edition, CC0 1.0 (public domain dedication); transcription originally from Project Gutenberg. Modified: converted to this format.
